text:
nina-sales: Heads up 10: AcmeCorp POC moving to PO stage but procurement flagged two items: they want ACH remittance vs our default wire, and they need DPA appendix signed before PO countersign.
procurement-jess: ACH is fine but we need bank details + EIN on the PO for vendor onboarding. Do they require a vendor form?
acme-reply (via email): they sent a vendor onboarding PDF and said ACH is preferred. Also asked for a shortened DPA with only data-retention and subprocessors sections.
leo-legal: Short DPA requests are common for POCs. We can do a limited DPA addendum focusing on retention and subprocessors, but no changes to liability or indemnity. Send me the buyer language.
ops-billing: Reminder: our billing flow needs either a W-9 (US) or W-8 (non-US) plus bank details for ACH. Without W-9 payment may be delayed.
nina-sales: Attached the buyer PDF (they listed remittance: "ACH to AcmeCorp, Routing xxxxx, Account yyyy"). They also wrote: "Please confirm Redwood will sign DPA addendum A with 30-day deletion window for POC data."
leo-legal: 30-day deletion for POC data is ok as long as the PII/Logs clause is scoped. I'll draft addendum A with a 30-day retention clause and a subprocessors list that references our standard annex. No SLA edits.
procurement-jess: Also ask them for the internal approver name/title for the PO (procurement contact + finance approver). We need explicit signer mapping on the PO.
eric-csm: If they want the 30-day deletion SLA to be operationalized, we should note who owns data deletion on the POC side and add an acceptance step. Otherwise ops will get pinged later.
leo-legal: Good point. I'll add a 1-line operational step: "Upon POC termination, Redwood will schedule deletion and provide confirmation to Acme procurement within 7 calendar days of request." Keeps it simple.
vendor-onboard-bot: Automated note: attach W-9 template link https://redwood.example/templates/W9 and vendor-onboard checklist. Missing docs will hold payment.
nina-sales: Plan: I will send a 1) DocuSign envelope with PO (incl EIN line), 2) W-9 request, 3) draft DPA addendum A. I'll route to @leo-legal for sign-off, then send to Acme Procurement and Acme Finance. ETA tomorrow morning.
procurement-jess: I'll ask buyer if ACH details are company-level or a centralized payments team. Need remittance address to set up vendor in ERP.
leo-legal: Quick note 0: Do NOT permit any countersignature that amends our SLA or payment terms. If buyer pushes net-term or SLA edits, escalate to legal and sales VP.
eric-csm: Once signed, I will attach all docs to the POC Zendesk ticket and create a short runbook for the deletion step so ops knows the owner.
nina-sales: Thanks all. I'll draft and ping when ready. If Acme insists on exec-level sign off, tag @ceo-sales for approval but hopefully not needed.
